items.description: Search PDFs and local document libraries with vera-cli to retrieve citation-ready context for AI agents. VERA converts PDFs into portable .vera archives containing text chunks, embeddings, figures, and source metadata, providing local keyword, semantic, and hybrid retrieval without a separate vector database or retrieval service. Use when answering questions from local documents, searching one archive or a document library, finding figures or page regions, checking archive integrity, converting PDFs, indexing a VERA library, or operating vera-cli.
